title: Review of c29's PPS lineage claim on fresh seed 5: S, I and D replicate (96 persistent splits, generation 2, 23 propagule splits); the genealogy is reticulate (merges 2668 vs splits 2550), so confidence is medium
summary: labkit re-run of the claimed world on seed 5 (t=30000) and c29's particle-identity tracker (ppstrack.py, unchanged settings) to t=60000. From uniform random particles, ring cells form by t~1200 and a population of ring cells and dense spores persists to the end (rerun/seed5/sheet.png). Tracker: 75.8 bodies on average in the second half, 96 persistent splits, max generation 2, 23 splits in which both daughters reach half the parent's size, median parent size 74.5 (claim: 63-111, generation 2-3, 12-36, 68-75). Raw events: 2550 splits and 2668 merges, so merges exceed half the splits and the genealogy is reticulate. Four random generation-2 splits (splits_s5_gen2.png): a 73-particle ring cell sheds a 20-particle spore and the ring persists (t=35500); two dense spores of 31-32 particles split into two halves (t=26500, 55500); one split follows the merger of two adjacent ring cells (t=26250-27250).

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: uniform random particles over the whole torus; rings by t=1200
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=1200-30000: discrete ring cells and spores at bounded size; 75.8 bodies on average in the second half (data/summary_s5.json)
observations.D: splits_s5_gen2.png row 1 (t=35500, 73 -> 50 + 20, ring persists past +1500) and rows 3-4 (spores 31 -> 16 + 17, 32 -> 18 + 15); 96 persistent splits, generation 2, 23 propagule splits (data/summary_s5.json)

seeds_run.result: pass: 96 persistent splits, max generation 2, 23 propagule splits; merge/split 1.05 on raw events

verdicts.limitation: Reticulate genealogy (2668 merges vs 2550 splits on seed 5), so confidence is capped at medium by RUBRIC L6; generation 2 on my seed; one of four random generation-2 splits follows a merger of two cells, and 'same kind' across ring cells and spores rests on the ring-spore life cycle seen in the strips, not on a body-plan statistic.
